## Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center

library(leaflet)

df <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/masterdf.csv")
df_subset = data.frame(lng = df$Longitude, lat = df$Latitude,
                     values = round(df$Fish_species_richness, 0))

pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "viridis", domain = df_subset$values,
                    na.color = "transparent")
metadata = paste0("Site ",df$Site, "<hr>", "Fish species richness: ", round(df$Fish_species_richness, 0))


leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%  # Satellite imagery
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 12) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = df_subset, color = ~pal(values), 
                   radius = 3, opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
                   popup = metadata) %>%
  addLegend(data = df_subset,
            position = "bottomright",
            pal = pal, values = ~values,
            title = "Fish species richness (out of 1500 reads)",
            opacity = 1)

```
